scripts.install:all: npx skills add . --skill bazi-persona -a codex -a claude-code -a cursor --copy -y
scripts.link:target: bash -lc 'test -n "$TARGET" || { echo "Usage: TARGET=/abs/path/to/project npm run link:target"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$TARGET/.agents/skills"; ln -sfn "$PWD" "$TARGET/.agents/skills/bazi-persona"; echo "linked -> $TARGET/.agents/skills/bazi-persona"'
scripts.unlink:target: bash -lc 'test -n "$TARGET" || { echo "Usage: TARGET=/abs/path/to/project npm run unlink:target"; exit 1; }; rm -rf "$TARGET/.agents/skills/bazi-persona"; echo "removed -> $TARGET/.agents/skills/bazi-persona"'
